posts.title: Custom Cables from LCSC

posts.title: A Hobby in Three Books, and a Bonus
posts.description: I have been in and out of the electronics space for most of my life. I started, like so many precocious children, with disassembling blenders, and toasters, and other things as a child, and typically putting them back together. They were often weight-optimized by leaving out random unneeded fasteners. But that was a long time ago, and until recently, the last time I designed any hardware in anger
